Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep royal-blue lapis surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID golden pyrite flecks scattered through every section, with carved relief of vines and leaves across the surface of every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved lapis lazuli.
